title: format_timespan(0, detailed=True) returns an empty string
property: formatting a valid zero timespan yields a non-empty human readable string (and parse_timespan of its parts gives back 0)
actual: '' (empty string), because all unit counts are zero and concatenate([]) is ''
evidence: Docstring: format_timespan(0) -> '0 seconds'; returns 'The formatted timespan as a string'. detailed only changes how milliseconds are represented, so zero should still render as a quantity.
